stories.title: FIFA suspends Argentina's Paredes for 10 games over World Cup final clashes
stories.summary: Several Argentina players including midfielder Leandro Paredes have been slapped with bans and fines for taking part in scuffles during the World Cup final against Spain in July. Paredes, who was banned for 10 international matches, was also fined $90,000.

stories.title: Russian forces hit Ukrainian naval patrol boat in port of Chernomorsk
stories.summary: Throughout the day, the Russian Armed Forces continued to strike ports and ships being used in the interests of the Ukrainian military
article_sentences: The Russian military on Friday hit a Ukrainian Navy patrol boat in the port of Chernomorsk, which was escorting ships carrying military cargo, and a fuel and lubricants tank in the port of Yuzhny, the Defense Ministry said.
Throughout the day, the Russian Armed Forces continued to strike ports and ships being used in the interests of the Ukrainian military.

"As a result of strikes by unmanned aerial vehicles, the following targets were hit: a Ukrainian naval patrol boat in the port of Chernomorsk, which was escorting ships carrying military cargo and a fuel and lubricants tank and port infrastructure facilities intended for storing military cargo in the port of Yuzhny," the ministry said.

stories.title: Millions in Cuba face water shortages as oil crisis deepens
stories.summary: In Cuba, seven months of an effective oil blockade imposed by the Trump administration has not only increased power outages but is also leaving more and more people without running water. In August 2025, 2.6 million people on the Caribbean island nation had difficulty accessing water, according to the Cuban Institute of Hydraulic Resources. Today, that figure has risen to 3.5 million – around a third of the population. FRANCE 24’s Ed Augustin reports on the health risks rippling through the island.
